 Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch Performance team. In this role, you will lead architectural and code-level performance engineering initiatives. Your goal is to drive the continuous optimization and predictability of Elasticsearch performance, partnering with area-specific teams to unlock the full potential of our software.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Owning core performance engineering initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of high-impact optimizations. Leading the technical design, plan, and execution for major architectural and code-level performance improvements.

About Vocantas 
 Vocantas provides workforce engagement and communication solutions for organizations where responsiveness and reliability are critical. Its platform helps customers improve staff communication, automate scheduling and outreach workflows, and increase operational efficiency. Vocantas supports organizations across North America in streamlining their processes and improving the experience for their staff and the people they serve. 
 Vocantas is part of Fluent Software Group (a Valsoft Corporation operating group), a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. We focus on specialized industries where expertise creates lasting advantages. 
 The Opportunity 
 Vocantas is looking for a Technical Account Manager to make sure our customers succeed after they buy, partnering with the Account Executive who owns each account. This role blends hands-on support, adoption strategy and product expertise. You’ll triage and resolve customer issues, work with internal teams to move them forward, present insights at QBRs, and identify opportunities to expand. 
 You’ll also have an opportunity to improve how the team operates by spotting gaps, suggesting practical solutions, and helping build stronger customer success processes as the organization evolves. 
 Location: Canada (remote) 
 While we aim to keep to regular business hours, this role requires the flexibility to support customers outside those hours, and across time zones, when urgent issues arise. 
 The salary for this role is $60,000–75,000 per year, plus an annual performance bonus and an uncapped expansion incentive. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. 
 What You’ll Own 
 Customer Support  
 Act as the first point of contact when customers in your portfolio experience an issue or need assistance. 
 Troubleshoot and resolve support tickets, bringing in Support, Product or Engineering when an issue needs their expertise. 
 Manage customer escalations and sensitive situations with clear communication and consistent follow-through. 
 Triage, Prioritization & Internal Communication  
 Triage and prioritize customer issues and activities across your portfolio to meet service commitments. 
 Work with Support, Product and Engineering on complex issues, providing the context needed to move them toward resolution, and keep customers informed throughout. 
 Track customer commitments, open action items, and internal follow-ups through to completion. 
 Engagement & Adoption Strategy  
 Lead onboarding activities for Enterprise customers, including milestone planning, progress tracking, and adoption support. 
 Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication, regular engagement, and a clear understanding of each customer’s needs. 
 Identify at-risk accounts early through customer feedback, usage trends, and engagement patterns, and proactively drive recovery plans. 
 QBRs & Account Strategy  
 Partner with the Account Executive on structured Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) focused on customer outcomes, adoption, and future priorities. 
 Present usage and value insights, and follow through on the action items that come out of each review. 
 Expansion & Renewals  
 Identify expansion opportunities across your accounts and support the Account Executive through to close. 
 Support renewal conversations with insight into account health, risks and value delivered. 
 Product Expertise & Continuous Improvement  
 Develop deep expertise in the Vocantas platform and serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customers on best practices and training them to get the most out of the product. 
 Look for gaps, inefficient processes, or recurring customer issues and bring forward practical solutions to improve how the team works. 
 Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to address customer needs and improve the overall customer experience. 
 Contribute to the development of customer success processes, playbooks, and AI-supported workflows. 
 What We’re Looking For 
 3–5 years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar customer-facing role within a B2B SaaS environment. 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work with customers by email and phone, lead meetings, and deliver training. 
 Comfortable troubleshooting and resolving a range of technical issues, and knowing when to bring in other teams. 
 Ability to triage and prioritize competing customer issues and activities. 
 Experience managing customer relationships, escalations, and onboarding and adoption initiatives. 
 Comfortable presenting data and insights to customer stakeholders. 
 Experience identifying expansion opportunities and supporting a sales partner through to close. 
 Ability to learn a product deeply and become a trusted advisor to customers. 
 An AI-first approach to your work: you look for ways AI and automation can make you faster, sharper and more scalable, and you bring those ideas to the team. 
 Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once. 
 Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams. 
 A proactive, solution-oriented mindset: you notice what is not working, bring forward ideas, and follow through on improvements. 
 Strongly Preferred  
 Experience serving customers in healthcare, public sector or manufacturing. 
 Experience using platforms such as Salesforce and Jira. 
 Experience working within organizations where processes and tooling are actively evolving. 
 Why Vocantas? 
 Make a visible impact: join a small team where your decisions, ideas, and improvements can directly influence the customer experience. 
 Own the customer relationship: become the person your accounts rely on, from ongoing partnership and guidance to solving day-to-day issues. 
 Work closely across the business: collaborate directly with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to get customers the answers and outcomes they need. 
 Help improve how the team works: identify what could work better and have a meaningful role in shaping processes, playbooks, and tools. 
 Entrepreneurial Energy: No two days look the same. You’ll work on meaningful problems with real business impact. 
 High Autonomy, High Impact: Own your work from Day 1 in a team that trusts you to deliver. 
 Learning-Driven Culture: A continuous improvement mindset across product, process, and people. 
 Join Us 
 Join Vocantas and become a trusted partner to our customers while solving real problems and helping us continuously improve how we support them.

 Working as part of a 24/7 team, Case Workers provide a consistent and welcoming presence within the stabilization program. They develop trusting relationships with residents, support day-to-day needs, identify emerging concerns, assist with service connections and contribute to individualized housing and stabilization plans.
 This position is well suited to someone who understands that stability begins with relationship, safety, dignity and consistency .
 The Case Worker does not work in isolation. They collaborate closely with the HART Hub Case Management, Housing, Primary Care, Addictions, System Navigation and leadership teams to ensure residents receive coordinated support.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Resident Support & Engagement 
 ·        Build respectful, professional and trusting relationships with residents.
 ·        Provide consistent frontline support to residents within the stabilization units.
 ·        Welcome new residents and assist with orientation to the program, expectations, services and available supports.
 ·        Conduct regular check-ins with residents and respond to identified needs.
 ·        Support residents with activities of daily living and practical problem-solving when required.
 ·        Promote resident choice, independence, dignity and self-determination.
 ·        Encourage participation in appropriate programming, appointments and community resources.
 ·        Support residents in maintaining connections with family, community and service providers where appropriate and desired.
 ·        Recognize changes in presentation, behaviour or circumstances and communicate concerns to the appropriate team member.
 Stabilization & Housing Support 
 ·        Work with residents to identify immediate priorities and goals.
 ·        Support residents in developing and following individualized stabilization plans.
 ·        Assist residents to identify barriers to housing and community stability.
 ·        Support residents with housing-related tasks and referrals in collaboration with the Housing and Case Management teams.
 ·        Assist residents in accessing identification, income supports, health services, appointments, transportation and other essential resources.
 ·        Encourage skills that support successful transition to permanent housing.
 ·        Participate in discharge and transition planning.
 24/7 Stabilization Operations 
 ·        Maintain a safe, welcoming and respectful environment within the stabilization program.
 ·        Complete scheduled wellness checks and resident contacts in accordance with HART Hub procedures.
 ·        Respond appropriately to resident concerns, incidents and urgent situations.
 ·        Follow established emergency, safety, incident reporting and escalation procedures.
 ·        Monitor the overall environment of the stabilization units and communicate emerging concerns to the appropriate supervisor.
 ·        Assist with maintaining clean, organized and welcoming common areas.
 ·        Support the consistent application of program policies and procedures.
 ·        Participate in shift handovers and ensure important information is communicated between shifts.
 ·        Work collaboratively with colleagues across all shifts to provide continuity of care.
 Documentation & Communication 
 ·        Maintain accurate, timely and objective client documentation in HIFIS and PSS.
 ·        Complete case notes, incident reports, shift documentation and other required records.
 ·        Document significant changes, concerns, interventions and follow-up requirements.
 ·        Maintain confidentiality and protect resident privacy.
 ·        Communicate effectively with colleagues and partner service providers within appropriate privacy and consent requirements.
 ·        Participate in team meetings, case conferences and other collaborative planning processes.
 Team Collaboration 
 ·        Work collaboratively with Case Managers, Housing Coordinators, System Navigators, Primary Care, Addictions staff, Program Coordinators and leadership.
 ·        Participate in multidisciplinary discussions regarding resident needs and service planning.
 ·        Provide relevant frontline observations to support coordinated case planning.
 ·        Contribute to a positive, respectful and supportive team culture.
 ·        Participate in training, supervision and professional development.
 What We Are Looking For 
 The successful candidate will demonstrate:
 ·        A strong commitment to working with individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability and complex barriers.
 ·        Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
 ·        A calm, compassionate and non-judgmental approach.
 ·        Ability to establish appropriate professional boundaries while building meaningful relationships.
 ·        Strong observation, communication and documentation skills.
 ·        Ability to remain calm and effective during challenging or unpredictable situations.
 ·        Understanding of trauma-informed and person-centred approaches.
 ·        Ability to work independently while functioning effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
 ·        Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
 ·        Respect for diversity, individual choice and lived experience.
 ·        Reliability and flexibility in a 24/7 service environment.
 Key Qualifications 
 ·        Post-secondary education in Social Services, Social Work, Human Services, Behavioural Sciences, Community Development or a related field is required.
 ·        Relevant education and/or equivalent experience will be considered.
 ·        1-2 year’s Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, housing instability, mental health concerns, substance use, poverty or other complex social barriers is an asset.
 ·        Experience in residential, shelter, supportive housing, outreach or other 24/7 social service environments is an asset.
 ·        Current Standard First Aid and CPR certification is required or must be obtained within the required timeframe.
 ·        Vulnerable Sector Screening is required.
 ·        Valid driver’s licence and access to reliable transportation may be required depending on program responsibilities.
 Core Competencies 
 Relationship-Based Practice : Builds trust while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
 Trauma-Informed Practice : Understands how trauma can affect behaviour, communication, relationships and engagement.

 Communication : Communicates clearly, respectfully and effectively with residents, colleagues and community partners.
 Documentation : Produces accurate, objective and timely documentation.

 We work well as a team and collaborate always!

A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a hands-on Fractional CFO to join our team! You will take over our finances end to end: not just projections, but actually running them. That means cash flow, the monthly close, payments, tax, budgets and the credit lines that fund our growth, for about 1-2 days a week.
 We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+ , and we want one person who owns the money so we don't run into problems as we double the business. We are looking to hire someone who has been CFO or VP of Finance for at least one DTC ecommerce brand doing $30M+ a year . The ideal candidate has run 13-week cash flows and monthly closes with a bookkeeper, has a deep understanding of subscription models, and has set up or managed an inventory- or receivables-backed credit facility.
 The mission of this role
 Own the company's money: cash, books, payments, projections and financial planning, so the CEO always knows where cash and profit stand today and where they are heading + improving terms, cash conversion cycle etc. Success is clear, accurate projections on cash flow, subscriptions and the cash conversion cycle so there are no surprises, books closed on time every month, and every payment and filing right and on time. You also own the company's credit lines, lender relationships and financial controls, so growth is always funded and every dollar is accounted for.
 Who are we?
 We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 Better Everyday: make the close, the cash forecast, payments and tax filing a bit faster and cleaner every month, and fix the root cause of every payment or booking error.
 Speed Is King: have the 13-week cash flow current before our Monday leadership meeting, pay bills and contractors on time, close the books on schedule, and flag a cash risk or overrun the week it shows up.
 Work Smart: automate finance work so a part-time role covers the whole function. Bank feeds and rules handle reconciliations, every tax and payment deadline has a scheduled reminder, Claude drafts the monthly finance summary from the closed books, and the cash flow forecast pulls actuals automatically.
 Overdeliver: bring the CEO the decision the numbers point to, not just the numbers, and find savings and cash-timing wins before being asked.
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 Cash flow, subscriptions and the cash conversion cycle are projected clearly, so there are no surprises: projections vs actuals; cash never below the minimum balance
 The books are accurate and closed on time every month: close date each month; no corrections needed after the P&L review with the CEO
 Everyone is paid right and on time: contractor pay, bills and payouts paid by their due date

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Inference Router team at Cerebras builds the systems that decide where every inference request runs. We route traffic across all of Cerebras’ data centers and third-party integrations, balancing heterogeneous compute, maximizing cache utilization, and delivering the industry’s lowest time-to-first-token (TTFT) at massive scale.

As an Engineering Manager, Inference Router, you will lead the team responsible for the intelligent control plane of the fastest generative AI inference platform in the world. Your team owns global request routing, prefill/decode (P/D) disaggregation, prefix-aware routing for high cache hit rates, autoscaling, and the high-availability infrastructure that keeps the platform fast and reliable under real-time, bursty load.

This role operates at the intersection of distributed systems, Kubernetes-based infrastructure, routing-algorithm design, and machine learning. It combines technical leadership, people management, and execution ownership, with direct impact on the latency, throughput, and reliability experienced by every Cerebras inference customer.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP

 - Own the architecture and evolution of the inference routing layer across all Cerebras data centers and third-party inference integrations.

 - Guide the design of:
   
   - global, multi-region request routing and load balancing;
   
   - routing for heterogeneous compute, including prefill/decode (P/D) disaggregated serving;
   
   - prefix-aware / cache-aware routing to maximize KV-cache reuse and utilization;
   
   - low-TTFT, high-throughput request scheduling under concurrent, bursty workloads.

 - Drive the routing algorithms that trade off cache locality, queueing, load, and latency in real time.

 - Invest in simulation: build high-fidelity models of the fleet and its workloads so the team can validate routing policies, failover behavior, and scaling decisions under a wide range of conditions without tying up precious accelerator capacity.

 - Partner with inference runtime, cloud/platform, hardware, and ML teams to optimize end-to-end performance.

TEAM LEADERSHIP

 - Build, manage, and grow a team of distributed systems, infrastructure, and ML systems engineers.

 - Provide technical direction, mentorship, and career development.

 - Foster a culture of ownership, velocity, and operational excellence.

 - Recruit top talent in distributed systems, Kubernetes/infrastructure, and routing/ML systems.

EXECUTION & DELIVERY

 - Drive execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning inference runtime, cloud/infrastructure, and ML teams.

 - Own delivery of capabilities such as:
   
   - prefix- and cache-aware routing policies;
   
   - P/D-disaggregation-aware scheduling and placement;
   
   - autoscaling and capacity management across heterogeneous fleets;
   
   - high availability, failover, and graceful degradation;
   
   - simulation and load-generation frameworks that exercise the router under diverse traffic patterns, failure modes, and fleet topologies — without consuming scarce production compute;
   
   - observability, SLOs, and reliability across the routing stack.

 - Ensure high-quality releases through strong testing, load/chaos validation, and operational rigor.

PLATFORM & PERFORMANCE OWNERSHIP

 - Scale the routing layer to handle very large volumes of concurrent requests at the lowest possible latency.

 - Drive improvements in TTFT, throughput, cache-hit rate, and compute efficiency across the fleet.

 - Design for reliability and high availability: failover, redundancy, scale-out, and fail-closed behavior under partial outages.

 - Identify and prioritize technical debt and system bottlenecks.

 - Maintain Cerebras’ industry-leading inference speed advantage.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Partner with:
   
   - inference runtime teams (execution and serving);
   
   - cloud/platform and SRE teams (deployment, scaling, reliability);
   
   - ML researchers and engineers (model enablement, routing signals);
   
   - third-party integration partners.

 - Act as a bridge between infrastructure, routing, and production systems.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 8+ years of experience in large-scale software engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure.

 - 2+ years of engineering management experience.

 - Strong programming skills in C++ and/or Go for performance-critical, concurrent production systems.

 - Deep experience operating production services on Kubernetes: deployments, autoscaling, rollout strategies, and multi-cluster/multi-region topologies.

 - Proven track record building and operating highly available, scalable systems: load balancing, failover, scale-out, and reliability engineering.

 - Experience designing or operating request routing, load balancing, scheduling, or traffic-management systems at scale.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure and best practices for building scalable microservices.

PREFERRED SKILLS

 - Experience with large-scale LLM/inference serving and the systems around it (e.g. vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, or comparable).

 - Familiarity with prefill/decode (P/D) disaggregation, KV-cache management, and prefix/cache-aware routing.

 - ML background: understanding of inference workloads, batching, and the performance characteristics of serving LLMs and multimodal models.

 - Experience with autoscaling and capacity management across heterogeneous compute.

 - Experience building simulation, modeling, or load-testing frameworks for distributed systems to validate behavior cost-effectively at scale.

 - Strong grounding in observability (metrics, tracing, SLOs) and incident response for high-traffic production systems.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

The Inference Router is the control plane behind Cerebras’ core promise: the fastest AI inference in the world. The routing decisions your team makes — across data centers, across heterogeneous compute, with cache-awareness and high availability — directly determine the latency, throughput, and reliability every customer experiences. Your work keeps real-time AI applications fast and dependable, and unlocks new capabilities across enterprise and frontier AI use cases.

 About the role 
 US Off-Price is a fast, reactive production book of licensed off-price programs shipped to club, mass and off-price retail. It runs high volumes across many factories and countries, on compressed timelines, with a heavy colour, packaging and compliance load and little room for error. The Production Manager takes senior operating ownership of this book, is the person who solves the day-to-day problems so they stop escalating to the Director, and grows into fuller ownership of sourcing, costing, governance and continuous improvement. The role frees the Director to focus on strategy, vendors and growth, and creates the coverage and redundancy the team currently lacks, so that no brand or book depends on a single person.
 Core responsibilities 
 Own from day one. 
 Own production end to end.  Take full operational ownership of the US Off-Price book from PO through delivery, drive the critical path, and be the person who solves problems and manages issues to resolution rather than passing them up.
 Manage the overseas factory base.  Own the day-to-day relationship and performance of factories across Pakistan, India, China, Cambodia and others: capacity, lead times, execution, issues and escalations.
 Oversee QC, inspection, testing and compliance.  Overlook the QCs and inspection reports, and ensure testing, regulatory and brand compliance, and importer and licensing documentation are all up to the mark.
 Drive shipments out.  Ensure goods ship on time, manage bookings and logistics, and clear blockers before they hit ex-factory and ship dates.
 Keep the system reflecting reality.  Ensure BlueCherry is always up to date with the real, current scenario: accurate POs, styles, BOMs, ex-factory and ship dates, and status, so the WIP is reliable for the whole business.
 Own the weekly cross-functional update.  Provide a clear weekly status update to Commercial, Shipping and Operations so the wider business works from one reliable view of the book.
 Be the coverage layer.  Step in and carry a coordinator's book when they are out, including backstopping the largest accounts, so absences no longer double the next day's work or land on the Director.
 Develop over the first 6 to 12 months. 
 Governance and KPI tracking.  Build and own the KPIs that run the book (on-time delivery, past-due, lead time, cost variance, factory scorecards, compliance status), track them, and report against them to drive accountability across the team and the factory base.
 Systems and tools for continuous improvement.  Develop dashboards, trackers and automation, including AI where useful, to cut manual work, surface issues early, and continuously improve how the team and the book run.
 Develop the team.  Give senior day-to-day guidance to a relatively junior coordinator group, raising their consistency and ownership over time.
 Required 
 Hands-on proficiency in BlueCherry (CGS), or a directly comparable apparel ERP/PLM, including PO and style setup, maintaining ex-factory and ship dates, BOMs, order tracking, EDI and reporting. BlueCherry experience is strongly preferred.
 Senior production or supply-chain background in apparel or import, with real ownership of factories and delivery, ideally in a fast, high-volume, high-SKU environment such as off-price, club or mass.

About the Role

North Vector Dynamics is building next-generation defence systems, and we’re scaling fast: from prototype builds to production, from a handful of people to a full team, and through our next stages of growth and financing. We’re looking for a Director of Finance to build the finance function behind it: the planning, reporting, controls, and capital strategy that let us make good decisions quickly and prove to investors, customers, and auditors that we can be trusted with their money. Reporting to the CEO directly, you’ll own our budget, forecast, and cash runway, run month-end and year-end, and turn our books into the numbers leadership and the board steer by.

This is a ground-floor role for someone who is rigorous, commercially minded, and energized by building systems from a clean sheet rather than inheriting them. You’ll work side by side with every department head, our bookkeeping and accounting support, our investors and board, and senior leadership, and your work will shape how far and how fast this company can grow.

If you want to build the financial foundation for a company whose platforms will one day support operators in the field, save lives, and serve sovereign national interest - this role was written for you.

What You’ll Do

Financial Planning & Analysis

• Own the annual budget and rolling forecast: setting up cost centers, building department budgets with each head, and reporting budget-to-actual variances every month.

• Build and maintain the company financial model and cash runway, modelling hiring plans, capital spending (including our new manufacturing facility), and program scenarios so leadership can see the trade-offs before committing.

• Produce monthly management reporting for leadership and the board: P&L by cost center, burn, runway, program costs, and the KPIs that tell us whether we’re on track.

Accounting, Controls & Compliance

• Own month-end and year-end close, the general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, and payroll oversight, building on our current bookkeeping foundation and growing the accounting team as we scale.

• Design the internal controls a defence supplier is held to: approval authorities, purchasing and expense policies, segregation of duties, and an audit trail that holds up to scrutiny.

• Manage our annual financial statement audit or review, corporate income tax, GST, and claims under SR&ED and other government incentive programs.

• Lead program and contract finance: cost estimating and pricing support for bids, milestone billing, revenue recognition, and contract cost accounting that meets Government of Canada and allied customer requirements.

Capital, Investors & Systems

• Support fundraising and investor relations: board and investor reporting, data rooms, and financial due diligence for future rounds, and manage the cap table and equity plan administration with legal counsel.

• Find, secure and manage non-dilutive funding: government grants, contribution programs, and innovation funding that extend our runway.

• Run treasury and banking: cash management, foreign exchange for international suppliers, credit facilities, and corporate insurance.

• Lead the finance side of our ERP selection and rollout: chart of accounts, cost-center structure, and clean integration with purchasing, inventory, and manufacturing.

• Step into whatever the mission demands: this is a startup, and no two weeks will look the same.

What You Bring

Required

• A CPA designation (or similar) in good standing, with a degree in accounting, finance, or business.

• 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading a finance function or team, ideally in a manufacturing or hardware company.

• Hands-on FP&A experience: building budgets, forecasts, and three-statement financial models from scratch, and presenting them clearly to non-finance leaders.

• Deep experience with month-end close, financial reporting under ASPE or IFRS, external audits, and Canadian corporate tax.

• Experience supporting a venture-backed or high-growth company through financing rounds, board reporting, and investor due diligence.

• A track record of standing up accounting systems, internal controls, and policies that scaled with the business.

• Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance and registration under the Controlled Goods Program; active clearance is a significant asset.

• A builder’s mindset: you take ownership of the system, not just the task, and you’re as comfortable building a model at midnight before a board meeting as you are designing the process that makes it unnecessary next time.

Preferred

• Experience in a defence or aerospace company, including government contract costing, pricing, and audit (Public Services and Procurement Canada, DND, or US DoD contracts).

• Experience preparing SR&ED claims and managing IRAP, IDEaS, or similar non-dilutive funding programs.

• Manufacturing cost accounting experience: standard costing, inventory valuation, work in progress, and cost of goods sold.

• Experience with Series B or later financings, venture debt, or other growth capital.

• Experience with equity plan administration and cap table tools such as Carta.

• Multi-entity or international experience: US or European subsidiaries, foreign exchange, and transfer pricing.

Why North Vector Dynamics

• Real ownership from day one: the systems and processes you help build will be foundational to how this company operates for years to come.

• A tight-knit, high-calibre team that moves fast, holds each other to a high standard, and doesn’t waste time on bureaucracy for its own sake.

ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

ABOUT YOUR ROLE

Fund administration is one of the most important and fastest-growing areas of the Juniper Square business, and how we win there depends on product marketing expertise that sits shoulder-to-shoulder with Sales. We're seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Fund Administration to partner with leadership on GTM strategy, as well as own the messaging, positioning, and enablement that move fund administration deals forward.

What sets this role apart: fund administration is a service, so understanding the offering means understanding the people who deliver it. You'll know our fund administration leaders and experts cold, including where each one is strongest, and you'll know our reference clients and how they differ across size, asset class, and profile. Keeping that picture current as the team scales fast is one of the most important parts of the job.

This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing and partners closely with Sales leadership and Pipeline.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Fund Administration strategy, positioning & messaging

 - Own Juniper Square's go-to-market strategy, positioning and messaging for the fund administration business unit, articulating a differentiated value proposition for each stakeholder in the buying group; CFOs, fund controllers, Heads of Finance and Fund Operations, leaders across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations, and technical evaluators.

 - Position Juniper Square's fund administration service so buyers understand not just what it delivers but how it changes the way their teams work, and prepare Sales and Customer Success to have credible, informed conversations about it.

 - Build the fund administration persona and industry playbooks: buyer and influencer roles, priorities, objections, and content needs at every stage of the sales journey.

Fund administration expertise & references

 - Build and maintain a living map of Juniper Square's fund administration leaders and experts: who presents well, where each one is strongest, and who to bring into a given deal or moment.

 - Keep that picture current through constant data-gathering as the fund administration team grows fast, so sales always knows who to pull in and when.

 - Maintain deep knowledge of our fund administration reference clients and how they vary by customer size, asset class, and profile, so sellers can match the right proof to the right prospect.

Fund administration launches

 - Own every fund administration product and feature launch end to end with repeatable frameworks that scale from major product announcements to quarterly release moments.

 - Define what launch readiness looks like and drive the cross-functional plan that gets there, so each release lands with Sales, Customer Success, and the market ready.

 - Close the loop after launch, feeding adoption signal and customer feedback back to Product to shape what ships next.

Sales enablement & deal support

 - Work directly with Sales leadership and top sellers to co-create the collateral that wins fund administration deals: executive briefs, ROI narratives, competitive battlecards, demo narratives, and stakeholder-specific decks for each stage of the buying process.

 - Drive pipeline, upsell, and cross-sell velocity across the GP experience and fund administration suite, maintaining a cohesive release narrative that keeps prospects and customers engaged across the lifecycle.

 - Act as the internal expert on fund administration deal dynamics, playing an active role in shaping messaging and strategy on high-stakes opportunities.

Voice of customer & competitive intelligence

 - Conduct deep voice-of-customer research through customer interviews, win/loss analysis, and Sales feedback to continuously enrich our understanding of fund administration personas and use cases across investor services, accounting, treasury, compliance, and loan operations.

 - Create the fund administration customer stories that validate our messaging with real-world proof.

 - Own competitive intelligence for the fund administration segment and disseminate actionable insights to Sales, Growth Marketing, and Product so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned around how these teams actually buy.

Build AI-native

 - Use AI agents and tooling as core infrastructure to research accounts, synthesize customer and competitive inputs, which measurably accelerates the production of messaging and enablement assets.

 - Apply judgment to what AI produces: know where automation accelerates the work and where human insight matters.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience in or adjacent to fund administration is required (at a fund administrator, on a fund CFO, controller, or finance operations team, or at a company selling fund administration technology or services); you understand how these teams operate, who the buyers are, and what they care about.

 - Experience in B2B product marketing or GTM strategy roles is advantageous but not required, with a strong bias toward supporting Sales and influencing deal outcomes.

 - AI Fluency: experience using LLMs, agents, and AI automation tools to measurably accelerate your work, and understanding where human judgment is critical.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; the ability to translate nuanced market insights into clear, compelling GTM artifacts.

COMPENSATION

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits.
